replace.observe: Obtain current actual scene evidence from named policy-visible views. This is read-only. Returned images describe the world now; derived point-cloud views contain no hidden state.
replace.mark_point: Measure one point from an exact returned view and pixel. Reuse point_id across complementary views when requested. This is read-only; solved XYZ is geometry, not object identity, contact, or a grasp verdict.
replace.preview_move: Render a candidate grip-site pose without acting. Supply absolute xyz_m or delta_mm plus optional orientation axes. The returned preview_id is bound to the current actual observation. Candidate images are not actual world state.
replace.move_pose: Execute one pose-only mutation, either from direct pose inputs or preview_id alone. It cannot open or close the gripper. Submission is not proof that the pose was reached; the next automatic actual observation reports the physical result.
replace.close_gripper: Execute one gripper-close mutation with no arguments. It cannot move the grip site. The next automatic actual observation reports measured aperture; closure alone is not contact or retention evidence.
replace.open_gripper: Execute one gripper-open mutation with no arguments. It cannot move the grip site. The next automatic actual observation reports measured aperture.
replace.report_issue: Record concise tool or context feedback without changing the world or ending the episode.
replace.check_task: Read the faithful LIBERO task result. This is read-only and is the only policy-visible task checker on this experimental surface.
replace.finish_episode: End the policy lifecycle. Success requires a prior check_task=true result; failure requires a reason and exhausted attempts.
